item.title: Incarico post-doc: Machine Learning and Integrative Modeling for the Characterization of Conformational Ensembles of Non-Canonical Nucleic Acids (Univ. PERUGIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-29 23:59
Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-03 Fisica sperimentale della materia e applicazioni

The project aims to develop and apply machine-learning and integrative modeling approaches to characterize conformational ensembles of non-canonical nucleic acids, with particular emphasis on G-quadruplexes. Experimental data from spectroscopic and scattering techniques will be combined with multiscale simulations and data-driven methods. The goal is to identify structural descriptors and relationships among sequence, topology, compactness, stability, and ligand interactions. Machine-learning algorithms will be used to classify conformational states and reduce parameter space. predictive models Will also be developed to connect experimental Observables with molecular properties. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Analysis and modelling of the propagation of disturbances generated by intense seismic events in the Earth’ atmosphere through machine learning techniques (Univ. della CALABRIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-20 12:00
Institution: Univ. della CALABRIA, Roma
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-05 Astrofisica e cosmologia, fisica dello spazio, della terra e del clima

The research activity will be carried out within Spoke 5 of the 'Space It Up!' project and will focus on the coupling between the lithosphere and the atmosphere associated with intense seismic events. In particular, the study of the atmospheric propagation of perturbations generated by seismic events will be conducted through data analysis and numerical models using machine learning techniques. The main activity will consist in developing numerical models aimed at describing the dynamics of these perturbations through the solutions of the fluid dynamics equations applied to the Earth's atmosphere. The models will be compared with results obtained from the analysis of atmospheric datasets…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Thermodynamic cost of Quantum Extreme Learning Machines (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-31 23:59
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-04 Fisica teorica della materia, modelli, metodi matematici e applicazioni

Extreme Learning Machines (ELMs) are feed-forward neural networks with a single hidden layer and random couplings, trained via linear regression, saving time and resources. Their quantum counterparts (QELMs) use a quantum reservoir to build complex representations of classical data, with inexpensive, noise-robust performance. The Quantum Theory Group at UNIPA has demonstrated the advantages of QELMs for validating and certifying quantum systems without tomographic reconstruction. These algorithms apply to the optimisation of complex processes, quantum and classical, on NISQ machines, to the energetic characterisation of biochemical systems simulated on quantum computers, and to the…
